comment: She is wonderful! She is very helpful and you can easily seek help outside the classroom. She knows what she is teaching very well and the class was very interesting. Loved taking her class !
She is a decent teacher. She is very passionate about what she teaches. At times, her class could be very repetitive. She grades fairly and very helpful outside of class
Do the work and you will be fine. Participate early and often and she will like you and go out of her way to help you.

What a wonderful professor! If you stay on top of the work and participate in class, you should be fine. Also, she is willing to assist students who go out of their way for extra help. She's passionate about the subject too, which helped keep us all interested in class. I highly recommend her!
